title.zh: 后期墨家关于光影、成像与力的讨论

rationale.zh: 匿名后期墨家文献讨论影、反射、小孔成像、力、运动与平衡，是中国古代物理思想的重要史料。
rationale.en: Anonymous later Mohist texts discuss shadows, reflection, pinhole images, force, motion and balance, providing important evidence for the history of Chinese physical thought.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Mohist Canons

dateNote.zh: 《墨经》主要编纂于公元前4世纪末至前3世纪中叶，不能全部归为墨子本人所作。这里以约前325至前250年表示这一文献形成时期。
dateNote.en: The Canons were largely compiled between the late fourth and mid-third centuries BCE and cannot all be attributed personally to Mozi. The approximate interval is 325–250 BCE.
